summary:
ASTROGUARD is an intelligent satellite monitoring system designed to continuously analyze satellite telemetry data and detect unusual behavior before it develops into a potentially serious issue.

Satellites generate large volumes of telemetry data, including temperature, power consumption, battery status, orbital information, sensor readings, and system health. Manually monitoring all these parameters is challenging, especially when changes occur gradually and are difficult to identify.

ASTROGUARD analyzes incoming data, establishes normal operating patterns, and identifies anomalies that deviate from expected behavior. When an anomaly is detected, the system alerts the team and provides useful information about what changed, when the change started, and how significantly the readings differ from normal values.

An anomaly does not necessarily indicate a confirmed malfunction; rather, it highlights unusual behavior that may require further investigation.

Through an interactive dashboard featuring satellite status, telemetry graphs, alerts, and anomaly details, ASTROGUARD aims to support earlier detection, improve operational awareness, and help maintain the reliability of satellite systems and space data.
details:
Project Overview

ASTROGUARD is a satellite telemetry monitoring and anomaly detection platform designed to help mission teams identify unusual satellite behavior and understand potential operational risks.

How It Works

The system monitors satellite telemetry parameters such as temperature, battery levels, power generation, orbital information, sensor readings, and subsystem health. It analyzes the incoming measurements and compares them against expected operating patterns.

When an unusual deviation is identified, ASTROGUARD generates an anomaly alert containing relevant details, including the affected parameter, the time the deviation began, and the difference between the observed value and its expected range.

The system is designed to support human decision-making. An anomaly is treated as an indication that further investigation may be needed, rather than automatic confirmation of a satellite malfunction.

Main Features

  • Satellite health monitoring dashboard.
  • Telemetry visualization through interactive graphs.
  • Detection of unusual data patterns.
  • Anomaly alerts and event tracking.
  • Detailed information about detected deviations.
  • Satellite status and subsystem monitoring.

Benefits and Intended Impact

ASTROGUARD aims to reduce the effort required for continuous manual monitoring, improve awareness of satellite operating conditions, and help teams identify potential issues earlier. By presenting anomalies in a clear and understandable format, it supports faster investigation and more informed operational decisions.

Innovation and Creativity

The project combines telemetry visualization, anomaly detection, and understandable alerts in one monitoring environment. Instead of simply displaying large volumes of satellite data, it focuses on identifying meaningful changes and explaining why they may deserve attention.

Development Tools and Technologies

The project is presented through a web-based interactive dashboard. The implementation technologies, programming languages, libraries, and anomaly detection methods should be listed according to the tools actually used by the development team.

Data Considerations

The system considers telemetry parameters, expected operating ranges, changes over time, and the distinction between unusual readings and confirmed system failures.
